notes:
• Fixed crashes and data loss when opening or re-recording certain lectures.
• Fixed lecture names with brackets (e.g. "[Topic]") showing up empty.
• Fixed lectures being wrongly marked "corrupted" while still compressing.
• Fixed summarization/transcription occasionally getting stuck on unstable networks.
• Factual correction mode now reliably defaults to on.
• Feedback logs no longer include your Windows username.
• Hardened update downloads and audio compression against interrupted connections.
• Faster NVIDIA key check on first-time setup.
